items.stem: Before the first postage stamps were introduced in Britain in 1840, the person who received a letter, rather than the sender, usually paid for it, so many letters were refused at the door.
options: Until postage stamps first appeared in Britain in 1840, letters were normally paid for by the people receiving them, not by those sending them, so many were turned away at the door.
Once the first postage stamps had been introduced in Britain in 1840, a letter was usually paid for by its recipient rather than its sender, so many letters were refused at the door.
Because many letters were being refused at the door, the person who received a letter in Britain, rather than the sender, usually paid for it until the first postage stamps appeared in 1840.
When the first postage stamps were introduced in Britain in 1840, many people at first refused them, since they were used to paying for letters on receiving them rather than on sending them.

explanation.he: המילה **Before** (לפני) שקולה כאן למילה **Until** (עד ש-): עד 1840 מי שקיבל מכתב שילם עליו, ובגלל זה (המילה **so**) מכתבים רבים נדחו בפתח הבית.
explanation.en: **Before** 1840 works like **Until** 1840 here: the person receiving a letter paid for it, **so** many letters were refused at the door.

items.stem: The leisure center opened a second pool last spring, which attracted more evening swimmers, but its income barely rose because most of the newcomers used the free family sessions.
options: Opening a second pool last spring brought the leisure center more evening swimmers, but its income barely rose because most of the newcomers used the free family sessions, which the council now plans to charge for.
A second pool, opened at the leisure center last spring, drew more evening swimmers, yet most of the new arrivals used the free family sessions, so income hardly increased.
The second pool that opened last spring attracted more evening swimmers to the leisure center, although its income barely rose.
The leisure center offered free family sessions last spring, which attracted more evening swimmers, but its income barely rose until it opened a second pool.

explanation.he: המשפט כולל ארבע יחידות: בריכה שנייה, יותר שחיינים בערב, הכנסה שכמעט לא עלתה (הצירוף **barely rose**) והסיבה (המילה **because**), והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על כולן ולא מוסיפה דבר.
explanation.en: Four units: a second pool, more evening swimmers, income that **barely rose**, and the reason (**because** newcomers used free sessions); the correct answer keeps all four and adds nothing.

items.stem: Although the restaurant's new head chef was hired by its owners, she had been recommended to them by the kitchen staff, several of whom she had trained years earlier.
options: Although the restaurant's new head chef was hired by the kitchen staff, she had been recommended to them by its owners, several of whom she had trained years earlier.
The restaurant's owners hired the new head chef on the kitchen staff's advice, and in the years since she was hired, she has gone on to train several of them herself.
Although the head chef had trained several members of the kitchen staff years earlier, the owners of the restaurant took them on without first asking for her recommendation.
The kitchen staff, several of whom had been trained by the restaurant's new head chef years before, suggested her to its owners, though it was the owners who hired her.

explanation.he: הצירוף **was hired by its owners** (נשכרה על ידי הבעלים) והצירוף **recommended to them by the kitchen staff** (הומלצה להם על ידי צוות המטבח) קובעים מי עשה מה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שני התפקידים.
explanation.en: The chef **was hired by its owners** but **recommended to them by the kitchen staff**; the correct answer keeps both roles and the earlier training.

items.stem: Not until they had slept normally for two nights did the volunteers kept awake in the study regain their usual reaction times, even though most of them reported feeling fully alert after the first.
options: Although most of the volunteers kept awake in the study said they felt fully alert after one normal night's sleep, the group's reaction times recovered only after a second night.
The volunteers kept awake in the study were back to their usual reaction times after a single night's normal sleep, though most of them still felt listless until the second.
Even after two nights of normal sleep, the volunteers kept awake in the study had not regained their usual reaction times, though most of them reported feeling fully alert after the first.
Not until the majority of the volunteers reported feeling fully alert did the study let them sleep normally for two nights, after which their usual reaction times returned.

explanation.he: הצירוף **Not until** (רק אחרי ש-) אומר שזמני התגובה חזרו לרגיל רק אחרי שני לילות שינה, אף שרוב המתנדבים הרגישו ערניים כבר אחרי הלילה הראשון, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שני הזמנים.
explanation.en: **Not until** two nights of normal sleep did reaction times recover, although most volunteers felt **fully alert after the first**; the correct answer keeps both times.

items.stem: In one study, people who doodled while listening to a dull phone message later recalled more of its details than those who simply listened, perhaps because doodling kept them from drifting into reverie.
options: One study showed that doodling while listening to a dull phone message makes people remember far more of its details, since it stops them from daydreaming.

Asked in advance to memorize a dull phone message, people in one study who doodled during the call later recalled more of its details than those who simply listened, perhaps because they were less prone to reverie.
In one study, people whose minds tended to drift into reverie doodled more while listening to a dull phone message, and later remembered less of what it said than those who simply listened.

Those who simply listened to a dull phone message in one study later remembered fewer of its details than people who doodled as they listened, possibly because doodling stopped their minds from wandering.

explanation.he: המשפט זהיר: מחקר אחד (הצירוף **In one study**), זכרו יותר פרטים, וסיבה משוערת בלבד (המילה **perhaps**), והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על ההסתייגויות ולא מוסיפה דבר.
explanation.en: The original is cautious (**In one study**, **perhaps because**); the correct answer keeps the comparison and the hedged reason without adding or strengthening anything.

items.stem: Hatched in the nest of a reed warbler, a young cuckoo pushes its foster parents' own eggs out of the nest, yet the warblers go on feeding the interloper for weeks.
options: A young reed warbler hatched in a cuckoo's nest pushes the cuckoo's own eggs out, and yet its foster parents keep feeding it for weeks.
For weeks, reed warblers go on feeding a young cuckoo that hatched in their nest, even though it has pushed their own eggs out of the nest.
A young cuckoo hatched in a reed warbler's nest is fed by the warblers for several weeks before it finally pushes their own eggs out of the nest.
Because the young cuckoo in their nest goes on feeding for weeks, the warblers push their own eggs out to make room for the interloper.

explanation.he: לפי המשפט הקוקייה הצעירה דוחפת החוצה את הביצים של הוריה המאמצים (הצירוף **foster parents' own eggs**), וציפורי הקנית ממשיכות להאכיל אותה (הצירוף **go on feeding the interloper**), והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על התפקידים.
explanation.en: The young cuckoo pushes out its **foster parents' own eggs**, yet the warblers **go on feeding the interloper**; the correct answer keeps who does what and when.

items.stem: A female cod may release millions of eggs a season, yet seldom do more than a handful of her progeny reach adulthood, a fraction that is usually enough to keep the population stable.
options: A female cod may release millions of eggs a season, of which a sizable minority usually survive into adulthood, a share that is enough to keep the population stable.
A female cod may release millions of eggs a season, and although a mere handful of her progeny usually reach adulthood, so small a fraction is seldom enough to keep the population stable.
Only rarely do more than a few of the millions of eggs a female cod may produce a season become adults, yet that small share is generally enough to keep the population steady.
Seldom does a female cod reach adulthood, yet the handful that do may release millions of eggs a season, usually enough to keep the population stable.

explanation.he: המילה **seldom** (לעתים רחוקות) והצירוף **more than a handful** (יותר מקומץ) אומרים שמעטים מאוד שורדים, והצירוף **usually enough** אומר שזה בכל זאת מספיק, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם.
explanation.en: **Seldom do more than a handful** survive, yet that fraction is **usually enough**; the correct answer keeps the tiny number and its sufficiency.

items.stem: Far from revealing a slipshod writer, the typos people overlook in their own work stem largely from knowing what they meant to say, which leads the brain to read the intended words instead.
options: Typos missed in one's own texts are no mark of carelessness; they come mostly from knowing the intended meaning, so the brain sees the words meant, not those written.
People tend to overlook typos in their own work largely because they already know just what they intended to say, which leads the brain to read the intended words instead.
The typos people overlook in their own work are largely the sign of a slipshod writer, rather than of a brain that reads the words it was expecting.
Writers who know what they meant to say are far from slipshod, so their brains tend to make them miss the typos in other people's work rather than the ones in their own.

explanation.he: הצירוף **Far from revealing a slipshod writer** (רחוק מלהעיד על כותב רשלן) שולל רשלנות, והצירוף **stem largely from knowing what they meant to say** נותן את הסיבה האמיתית, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם.
explanation.en: **Far from revealing a slipshod writer** rules out carelessness, and **stem largely from knowing what they meant to say** gives the real cause; the correct answer keeps both.

items.stem: Even when told outright that their pills contained no active ingredient, a good number of patients in some trials reported that their symptoms had eased, though measurable signs of the underlying malady seldom changed.
options: Even after learning that their pills held no active ingredient, many patients in some trials found that their symptoms had vanished, though objective signs of the illness itself seldom changed.
In some trials, quite a few patients said they felt better even after being openly informed that their pills were inactive, although objective measures of the disease itself rarely showed a change.

Even when told outright that their pills contained no active ingredient, most patients in the trials reported that their symptoms had eased, though measurable signs of the underlying malady seldom changed.

Patients in some trials who were told outright that their pills contained no active ingredient seldom reported that their symptoms had eased, although measurable signs of the underlying malady changed in a good number of them.

explanation.he: הטענה במשפט מוגבלת: לא מעט מטופלים (הצירוף **a good number of patients**), רק בחלק מהניסויים (הצירוף **in some trials**), דיווחו על הקלה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על ההיקף ועל הניגוד מול הסימנים המדידים.
explanation.en: The original is limited (**a good number of patients**, **in some trials**, symptoms **had eased**); the correct answer keeps this scope and the contrast with signs that **seldom changed**.

items.stem: My little brother is afraid of the dark, so he sleeps with a ________ on all night.
options: pillow
lamp
fan
mirror

explanation.he: הילד פוחד מהחושך (**afraid of the dark**), ולכן הוא ישן עם משהו שדולק כל הלילה (**on all night**): מנורה (**lamp**).
explanation.en: He is **afraid of the dark**, so he sleeps with something **on all night**: a **lamp**, which gives light.

items.stem: My little sister is small, but she is very ________ and can carry her own bag.
options: thin
lonely
strong
pretty

explanation.he: המילה **but** (אבל) מסמנת ניגוד לכך שהאחות קטנה (**small**), והיכולת לשאת תיק (**can carry her own bag**) מראה שהיא חזקה (**strong**).
explanation.en: **But** signals a contrast with **small**, and being able to **carry her own bag** shows that she is **strong**.

items.stem: My uncle is very ________ – he has a big house by the sea and three new cars.
options: rich
poor
ugly
sad

explanation.he: ההסבר שאחרי המקף, **he has a big house by the sea and three new cars** (יש לו בית גדול ליד הים ושלוש מכוניות חדשות), מראה שהדוד עשיר (**rich**).
explanation.en: The explanation after the dash, **he has a big house by the sea and three new cars**, tells us that the uncle is **rich**.

items.stem: She packed some warm ________ for the trip, such as a coat, two sweaters and a scarf.
options: dishes
blankets
tools
clothes

explanation.he: הצירוף **such as** (כמו) מציג דוגמאות: מעיל, שני סוודרים וצעיף (**a coat, two sweaters and a scarf**), וכל אלה הם בגדים (**clothes**).
explanation.en: The examples after **such as**, **a coat, two sweaters and a scarf**, are all things to wear: **clothes**.

items.stem: My dentist told me to ________ my teeth twice a day.
options: iron
sweep
brush
comb

explanation.he: הפועל **brush** יוצר צירוף קבוע עם הביטוי **my teeth** (לצחצח שיניים), וזה מה שרופא שיניים (**My dentist**) מייעץ לעשות פעמיים ביום.
explanation.en: The verb **brush** forms a fixed phrase with **my teeth**, which is what **My dentist** advises doing twice a day.

items.stem: Dan climbed the ________ to pick apples from the top of the tree.
options: ladder
wallet
mountain
candle

explanation.he: המטרה, **to pick apples from the top of the tree** (לקטוף תפוחים מראש העץ), מחייבת חפץ גבוה שאפשר לטפס עליו: סולם (**ladder**).
explanation.en: To **pick apples from the top of the tree**, Dan needs something tall to climb: a **ladder**.

items.stem: Last night, the children ________ happy birthday to my grandmother.
options: sung
sang
sings
sing

explanation.he: הצירוף **Last night** (אמש) מסמן זמן עבר, ולכן הפועל חייב להיות בצורת העבר: **sang** (הם שרו).
explanation.en: **Last night** marks the past, so the verb must be in the past simple: **sang**.

items.stem: Mia has a very high temperature and a bad cough, so she is ________ today.
options: tall
rude
tidy
ill

explanation.he: המילה **so** (ולכן) מציגה תוצאה: חום גבוה ושיעול (**a very high temperature and a bad cough**) הם סימני מחלה, ולכן מיה חולה (**ill**).
explanation.en: **So** introduces the result: **a very high temperature and a bad cough** are signs of sickness, so Mia is **ill**.

items.stem: Lily felt ________ after spinning around ten times, so she sat down on the grass.
options: silly
serious
dizzy
brave

explanation.he: המילה **so** (ולכן) מחברת בין הסיבה **spinning around ten times** (סיבוב עשר פעמים) לבין ישיבה על הדשא: מי שמסתובבת כך מרגישה סחרחורת (**dizzy**).
explanation.en: **So** links **spinning around ten times** to sitting down: after spinning like that a person feels **dizzy**.

items.stem: The street is very ________, which means that two cars cannot pass each other.
options: steep
narrow
empty
winding

explanation.he: הצירוף **which means that** (כלומר) מסביר את המילה החסרה: **two cars cannot pass each other** (שתי מכוניות לא יכולות לחלוף זו על פני זו), ורחוב כזה הוא צר (**narrow**).
explanation.en: The phrase **which means that** explains the blank: if **two cars cannot pass each other**, the street is **narrow**.

items.stem: Many ________ live in our garden, such as ants, bees and flies.
options: birds
rabbits
snakes
insects

explanation.he: הצירוף **such as** (כמו) מציג נמלים, דבורים וזבובים (**ants, bees and flies**), וכל אלה הם חרקים (**insects**).
explanation.en: The examples after **such as**, **ants, bees and flies**, are all small animals with six legs: **insects**.

items.stem: Look left and right before you ________ the street.
options: cross
climb
block
repair

explanation.he: הפועל **cross** יוצר צירוף קבוע עם הביטוי **the street** (לחצות את הרחוב), ולפני חציית רחוב מסתכלים שמאלה וימינה (**Look left and right**).
explanation.en: The verb **cross** forms a fixed phrase with **the street**, and people **Look left and right** before crossing.

items.stem: After losing every game, the players feel ________: they do not believe they can ever win.
options: hopeless
fearless
breathless
speechless

explanation.he: הסיומת **-less** פירושה בלי: שחקנים שאינם מאמינים שינצחו אי פעם (**they do not believe they can ever win**) הם בלי תקווה, כלומר מיואשים (**hopeless**).
explanation.en: The suffix **-less** means without: players who **do not believe they can ever win** are without hope, so they feel **hopeless**.

items.stem: The magic show was ________, and the children clapped for a long time.
options: amazed
amazing
amaze
amazingly

explanation.he: הנושא **The magic show** הוא דבר שגורם להרגשה אצל אחרים, ולכן מתארים אותו בתואר **amazing** (מדהים) ולא בתואר **amazed** (נדהם).
explanation.en: **The magic show** causes the feeling in others, so it is **amazing**; **amazed** describes the people who feel it.

items.stem: When she reads the newspaper, my aunt puts on her ________ because she cannot see small letters.
options: boots
gloves
slippers
glasses

explanation.he: מי שאינה רואה אותיות קטנות (**she cannot see small letters**) כשהיא קוראת עיתון מרכיבה משקפיים (**glasses**).
explanation.en: A person who **cannot see small letters** while reading the newspaper puts on **glasses**.

items.stem: The film starts in ten minutes, so we must ________ to get there on time.
options: hurry
rest
shake
pour

explanation.he: המילה **so** (ולכן) מחברת בין הסיבה **The film starts in ten minutes** (הסרט מתחיל בעוד עשר דקות) לבין מה שצריך לעשות כדי להגיע בזמן (**to get there on time**): למהר (**hurry**).
explanation.en: The word **so** links **The film starts in ten minutes** to what we must do to arrive **on time**: **hurry**.

items.stem: My bedroom is very ________: there are clothes, books and shoes all over the floor.
options: dim
messy
damp
stuffy

explanation.he: אחרי הנקודתיים בא הסבר: **clothes, books and shoes all over the floor** (בגדים, ספרים ונעליים בכל רחבי הרצפה), וחדר כזה הוא מבולגן (**messy**).
explanation.en: The part after the colon explains the blank: **clothes, books and shoes all over the floor** means that the room is **messy**.

items.stem: The shop sells beautiful ________, such as tables, chairs and beds.
options: souvenirs
vehicles
jewelry
furniture

explanation.he: הצירוף **such as** (כמו) מציג דוגמאות למילה החסרה: **tables, chairs and beds** (שולחנות, כיסאות ומיטות), והמילה שכוללת את כולן היא ריהוט (**furniture**).
explanation.en: The phrase **such as** introduces examples of the blank: **tables, chairs and beds** are all **furniture**.

items.stem: Dan learned how to ________ a knot in the rope before he hung the swing from the tree.
options: stretch
fold
tie
bend

explanation.he: המילה **knot** (קשר) יוצרת עם הפועל **tie** (לקשור) צירוף קבוע: אומרים **tie a knot** ולא **stretch a knot**, **fold a knot** או **bend a knot**.
explanation.en: The noun **knot** goes with the verb **tie**: we say **tie a knot**, not **stretch**, **fold** or **bend** a knot.

items.stem: The nurse put a ________ on my finger because it was bleeding.
options: ring
bracelet
bandage
ribbon

explanation.he: המילה **because** (כי) מסבירה למה האחות (**nurse**) שמה משהו על האצבע: **it was bleeding** (היא דיממה), ולכן היא שמה תחבושת (**bandage**) שמכסה את הפצע.
explanation.en: The word **because** gives the reason: **it was bleeding**, so the nurse put a **bandage** on the finger.

items.stem: Although the new manager seemed ________ when she arrived, she soon became the most popular person in the office.
options: charming
selfish
enthusiastic
capable

explanation.he: המילה **Although** (למרות ש-) מסמנת ניגוד: מכיוון ש-**she soon became the most popular person** (היא הפכה במהרה לאדם הכי פופולרי), הרושם הראשון היה שלילי: **selfish** (אנוכית).
explanation.en: **Although** signals contrast: since **she soon became the most popular person**, her first impression was negative, so she seemed **selfish**.

items.stem: The new hiking boots are ________, that is, your feet stay dry even when you walk through heavy rain for hours.
options: lightweight
fashionable
tough
waterproof

explanation.he: הצירוף **that is** (כלומר) מסביר את המילה החסרה: **your feet stay dry even when you walk through heavy rain** (הרגליים נשארות יבשות גם בגשם חזק), וזה פירוש המילה **waterproof** (אטום למים).
explanation.en: The phrase **that is** introduces an explanation: if **your feet stay dry even when you walk through heavy rain**, the boots are **waterproof**.

items.stem: Because it was ________ cold outside, the school canceled the sports day and kept all the children indoors.
options: bitterly
firmly
intensively
gently

explanation.he: המילה **cold** (קר) יוצרת עם המילה **bitterly** את הצירוף הקבוע **bitterly cold** (קר מאוד), וההמשך **canceled the sports day** מתאים לקור עז.
explanation.en: The word **cold** forms the fixed phrase **bitterly cold** (extremely cold), and the result **canceled the sports day** fits a severe cold.

items.stem: Before you clean the toaster, you must ________ it, so that no electricity goes through it while you work.
options: unpack
unzip
unbutton
unplug

explanation.he: המטרה **so that no electricity goes through it** (כדי שלא יעבור בו חשמל) מחייבת לנתק את הטוסטר, והתחילית **un-** (ביטול פעולה) עם המילה **plug** (תֶּקַע) נותנת **unplug** (לנתק מהחשמל).
explanation.en: The purpose **so that no electricity goes through it** means the toaster must be disconnected: **un-** (undo) + **plug** = **unplug**.

items.stem: Whereas the new reading room is full of students chatting at every table, the old library was so ________ that visitors whispered.
options: vibrant
spacious
silent
smelly

explanation.he: המילה **Whereas** (בעוד ש-) מציבה ניגוד: בחדר החדש התלמידים משוחחים (**chatting at every table**), ולכן הספרייה הישנה הייתה ההפך: **silent** (דוממת, ללא קול).
explanation.en: **Whereas** sets up a contrast: the new room is full of students **chatting at every table**, so the old library was the opposite: **silent**.

items.stem: Many dangerous sports require special ________, for example helmets, gloves and knee pads, which protect the body from injury.
options: coaching
equipment
tournaments
referees

explanation.he: הצירוף **for example** (למשל) מציג דוגמאות למילה החסרה: **helmets, gloves and knee pads** (קסדות, כפפות ומגני ברכיים), והשם הכללי להן הוא ציוד (**equipment**).
explanation.en: The phrase **for example** introduces examples of the blank: **helmets, gloves and knee pads** are all **equipment**.

items.stem: Unless the bakery ________ more workers soon, it will not be able to serve all of its customers.
options: hires
will hire
hired
hiring

explanation.he: אחרי **Unless** (אלא אם כן) באה צורת הווה פשוט גם כשהכוונה לעתיד, ולכן הצורה **hires** מתאימה, וההמשך **it will not be able** כבר מבטא את העתיד.
explanation.en: After **Unless** we use the present simple even for the future, so **hires** fits; **it will not be able** already carries the future meaning.

items.stem: The desks were in long rows, which made group work difficult, so the teacher decided to ________ them into small circles.
options: reprint
rethink
rearrange
recalculate

explanation.he: המילה **so** (ולכן) מראה שבגלל השורות הארוכות (**in long rows**) המורה החליטה לסדר את השולחנות מחדש, והתחילית **re-** (שוב, מחדש) עם המילה **arrange** (לסדר) נותנת **rearrange** (לסדר מחדש).
explanation.en: The word **so** shows that because the desks were **in long rows**, the teacher put them in a new order: **re-** (again) + **arrange** = **rearrange**.

items.stem: The jacket was half price, so it was a real ________ and I bought two of them.
options: bargain
disaster
receipt
refund

explanation.he: המילה **so** (ולכן) מחברת את המחיר הזול (**half price**, חצי מחיר) לתוצאה: זו הייתה עסקה משתלמת (**bargain**), ולכן קניתי שניים.
explanation.en: The word **so** links **half price** to the result: it was a real **bargain** (a very good deal), so I bought two.

items.stem: My grandfather is a ________ man – in other words, he rarely changes his mind, even when everyone disagrees with him.
options: humble
timid
obedient
stubborn

explanation.he: הצירוף **in other words** (במילים אחרות) מסביר את המילה החסרה: המשפט **he rarely changes his mind, even when everyone disagrees with him** מתאר אדם עיקש (**stubborn**).
explanation.en: **In other words** explains the blank: a man who **rarely changes his mind, even when everyone disagrees with him**, is **stubborn**.

items.stem: After months without rain, the stream behind our house became so ________ that the children could walk across it without getting their knees wet.
options: swift
shallow
muddy
sparkling

explanation.he: הצירוף **so ... that** מסמן תוצאה: הילדים חצו את הנחל בלי שהברכיים נרטבו (**walk across it without getting their knees wet**), ולכן המים היו **shallow** (רדודים).
explanation.en: **So ... that** introduces a result: the children could **walk across it without getting their knees wet**, so the stream was **shallow** (not deep).

items.stem: Many people feel ________ after a big meal, but a short walk in the fresh air usually wakes them up again.
options: satisfied
refreshed
drowsy
curious

explanation.he: המילה **but** מעמידה מול התחושה החסרה הליכה שמעירה אנשים (**a short walk in the fresh air usually wakes them up again**), ולכן התחושה היא **drowsy** (מנומנם).
explanation.en: **But** contrasts the missing feeling with a walk that **wakes them up again**, so the feeling is **drowsy** (half asleep).

items.stem: While Anna spends her salary as soon as she receives it, her brother is ________ and saves half of every month's pay.
options: thrifty
reckless
sociable
jealous

explanation.he: המילה **While** מעמידה את האח מול אנה, שמוציאה את המשכורת מיד (**spends her salary as soon as she receives it**), ולכן הוא **thrifty** (חסכן) וחוסך חצי ממנה.
explanation.en: **While** contrasts the brother with Anna, who **spends her salary as soon as she receives it**, so he is **thrifty** (careful with money).

items.stem: The mushrooms sold at this market are ________, which means that people can eat them without any danger.
options: toxic
fragrant
ripe
edible

explanation.he: הצירוף **which means** מגדיר את החסר: אפשר לאכול את הפטריות בלי סכנה (**people can eat them without any danger**), ולכן הן **edible** (ראויות למאכל).
explanation.en: **Which means** defines the blank: **people can eat them without any danger**, so the mushrooms are **edible** (safe to eat).

items.stem: The small island is ________: its ground is so dry that almost nothing grows there, not even a single tree.
options: rugged
barren
lush
windswept

explanation.he: הנקודתיים מציגות הסבר: האדמה יבשה כל כך שכמעט שום דבר אינו צומח בה (**almost nothing grows there**), ולכן האי הוא **barren** (עקר, חסר צמחייה).
explanation.en: The colon introduces an explanation: **almost nothing grows there**, so the island is **barren** (without plants).

items.stem: Families on low incomes often struggle to pay for basic ________, such as food, housing and heating.
options: celebrations
hobbies
necessities
gadgets

explanation.he: הצירוף **such as** מביא דוגמאות לחסר: אוכל, דיור וחימום (**food, housing and heating**) הם דברים הכרחיים, כלומר **necessities** (צרכי יסוד).
explanation.en: **Such as** gives examples of the blank: **food, housing and heating** are things people must have, so they are **necessities** (basic needs).

items.stem: After the long walk, the scouts decided to ________ their tents beside the lake before it got dark.
options: pitch
hoist
stick
hang

explanation.he: הפועל **pitch** יוצר עם המילים **their tents** את הצירוף הקבוע **pitch a tent** (להקים אוהל), ולכן הוא מתאים למה שחברי הקבוצה עושים ליד האגם (**beside the lake**); שאר הפעלים אינם נאמרים עם אוהל.
explanation.en: **Pitch** forms the fixed phrase **pitch a tent** (set up a tent) with **their tents**, which fits what the scouts do **beside the lake**.

items.stem: The company sells its products ________, in more than ninety countries on five continents.
options: nationwide
citywide
statewide
worldwide

explanation.he: המילה **worldwide** בנויה מ-**world** (עולם) ו-**wide** (רחב), והיא מתאימה לפירוט שאחרי הפסיק: יותר מתשעים מדינות בחמש יבשות (**more than ninety countries on five continents**).
explanation.en: **Worldwide** is **world** plus **wide** (everywhere), and it matches the detail after the comma: **more than ninety countries on five continents**.

items.stem: Because the town's youth orchestra ________ entirely by local businesses, it can offer free lessons to every child.
options: sponsored
has sponsored
is sponsored
was sponsoring

explanation.he: התזמורת אינה נותנת חסות לאיש אלא מקבלת אותה, והנותנים נזכרים אחרי המילה **by** (**by local businesses**), ולכן דרושה צורת סביל בהווה: **is sponsored** (נתמכת בחסות).
explanation.en: The orchestra does not sponsor anyone; it receives support, and the givers follow **by** (**by local businesses**), so a present passive is needed: **is sponsored**.

items.stem: The power went out on Friday night, and nobody opened the refrigerator for two days; as a result, most of the fresh food inside began to ________ in the warm kitchen.
options: squeeze
spoil
melt
swallow

explanation.he: הצירוף **as a result** מסמן תוצאה: יומיים בלי חשמל ובמטבח חם (**in the warm kitchen**), ולכן האוכל הטרי התחיל להתקלקל, כלומר **spoil**.
explanation.en: The phrase **as a result** introduces the consequence: two days without power in **the warm kitchen** make the fresh food begin to **spoil** (go bad).

items.stem: Although the new school was praised for its bright, modern classrooms, teachers complained that the supply of textbooks was ________, so students often had to share one book among three.
options: voluntary
splendid
sufficient
inadequate

explanation.he: המילה **Although** מעמידה מול השבח על הכיתות תלונה של מורים, והמילה **so** מראה שתלמידים חולקים ספר אחד (**share one book among three**), ולכן האספקה הייתה **inadequate** (לא מספקת).
explanation.en: **Although** sets the teachers' complaint against the praise, and **so** shows that students **share one book among three**, so the supply was **inadequate** (not enough).

items.stem: Although the singer's first album was praised for its variety, her latest one is ________: that is, nearly every song uses the same rhythm and the same melody.
options: repetitive
varied
whimsical
imaginative

explanation.he: הצירוף **that is** מסביר את החסר: כמעט כל שיר משתמש באותו קצב ובאותה מנגינה (**the same rhythm and the same melody**), ולכן האלבום הוא **repetitive** (חוזר על עצמו), בניגוד למגוון באלבום הראשון.
explanation.en: **That is** explains the blank: **the same rhythm and the same melody** in nearly every song make the album **repetitive**, unlike the first one's **variety**.

items.stem: Although some desserts, such as fruit salad and plain yogurt, are ________ for the body, others, such as chocolate cake and fried doughnuts, contain a great deal of sugar and fat.
options: fattening
stimulating
nutritious
delicious

explanation.he: הדוגמאות **fruit salad and plain yogurt** והניגוד עם קינוחים שיש בהם הרבה סוכר ושומן (**a great deal of sugar and fat**) מורים על התשובה **nutritious** (מזינים).
explanation.en: The examples **fruit salad and plain yogurt**, set against desserts with **a great deal of sugar and fat**, point to **nutritious** (good for the body).

items.stem: Although the two scientists examined exactly the same data, they ________ it in opposite ways: one saw proof that the treatment worked, and the other saw proof that it failed.
options: published
interpreted
transferred
compared

explanation.he: ההמשך אחרי הנקודתיים (**one saw proof that the treatment worked, and the other saw proof that it failed**) מראה שכל מדען הבין את אותם נתונים אחרת, כלומר **interpreted** (פירשו).
explanation.en: After the colon, one scientist **saw proof that the treatment worked** and the other **saw proof that it failed**, so they **interpreted** (explained the meaning of) the same data differently.

items.stem: Although paying by card is faster than counting out cash, its main ________ is that spending feels less real, so people often buy more than they planned.
options: perk
highlight
drawback
convenience

explanation.he: המילה **Although** (למרות ש) פותחת ביתרון של תשלום בכרטיס, וההמשך **spending feels less real** מתאר בעיה, ולכן החסר הוא **drawback** (חיסרון, צד שלילי).
explanation.en: **Although** opens with an advantage of paying by card, and **spending feels less real** describes a problem, so the blank is **drawback** (a downside).

items.stem: Although many people at first dismissed the microwave oven as a gimmick, families across the country soon ________ it as a quick way to heat a meal after a long day.
options: vilified
embraced
outlawed
mocked

explanation.he: המילה **Although** והמילה **soon** מסמנות מעבר מדחייה של התנור (**dismissed the microwave oven as a gimmick**) לאימוץ שלו, ולכן המשפחות **embraced** (אימצו בהתלהבות) אותו.
explanation.en: **Although** and **soon** mark a shift from rejection (**dismissed the microwave oven as a gimmick**) to acceptance, so families **embraced** (welcomed eagerly) it.

items.stem: Although the review panel praised the proposal for its ambition, it also called it ________; that is, impossible to carry out with the money and staff available.
options: infeasible
unadventurous
unremarkable
innovative

explanation.he: הצירוף **that is** מגדיר את החסר: תוכנית שאי אפשר לבצע עם הכסף והצוות שיש (**impossible to carry out with the money and staff available**) היא **infeasible** (בלתי ניתנת לביצוע), בניגוד לשבח על השאפתנות.
explanation.en: **That is** defines the blank: a plan **impossible to carry out with the money and staff available** is **infeasible**, which contrasts with the praise for its ambition.

items.stem: Although the region now relies on tourism and software, its hills are still dotted with ________ of the old mining industry, such as rusted carts, stone wells and half-buried rails.
options: revenues
remedies
riddles
relics

explanation.he: הצירוף **such as** מציג דוגמאות (**rusted carts, stone wells and half-buried rails**) שנותרו מתעשיית הכרייה (**mining industry**), והמילה **Although** מעמידה אותן מול כלכלת היום, ולכן החסר הוא **relics** (שרידים).
explanation.en: **Such as** gives old leftovers (**rusted carts, stone wells and half-buried rails**), and **Although** contrasts them with today's economy, so the blank is **relics** (objects left from the past).

items.stem: Although the factory owner denied any wrongdoing, he went to great ________ to keep the inspectors away from the accounts.
options: distances
lengths
depths
extents

explanation.he: הצירוף הקבוע **went to great lengths** (עשה מאמץ יוצא דופן) מתאים כאן: המילה **Although** מעמידה את הכחשת העוולה (**denied any wrongdoing**) מול המאמץ **to keep the inspectors away**.
explanation.en: The fixed phrase **went to great lengths** (made an extreme effort) fits: **Although** sets his denial of wrongdoing (**denied any wrongdoing**) against his effort **to keep the inspectors away**.

items.stem: Although Ms. Ruiz is usually calm in meetings, her sharp reply yesterday was completely ________, and several colleagues asked whether she was unwell.
options: uninspired
unconstitutional
uncharacteristic
untroubled

explanation.he: המילה **Although** מעמידה את התגובה החדה מול ההתנהגות הרגועה הרגילה (**usually calm in meetings**), ולכן היא **uncharacteristic** (שאינה אופיינית לה), והשאלה אם היא חולה (**asked whether she was unwell**) מאשרת זאת.
explanation.en: **Although** contrasts the sharp reply with her usual calm (**usually calm in meetings**), so it was **uncharacteristic** (not typical of her), and colleagues asking whether she was **unwell** confirms it.

items.stem: Although safety inspectors had warned of the danger for years, the transport authority grew ________, assuming that nothing serious would ever happen.
options: complacent
resentful
cooperative
diligent

explanation.he: הסוף **assuming that nothing serious would ever happen** מראה סיפוק עצמי ורשלנות, והמילה **Although** מעמידה אותו מול האזהרות של הפקחים (**had warned of the danger for years**), ולכן הרשות נעשתה **complacent** (שאננה).
explanation.en: **Assuming that nothing serious would ever happen** shows careless self-satisfaction, set by **Although** against years of warnings (**had warned of the danger for years**), so the authority grew **complacent**.

items.stem: Whereas the old city center is crowded from morning until midnight, the new suburbs are so ________ after dark that a resident can walk for ten minutes without meeting a single person.
options: festive
gloomy
dazzling
deserted

explanation.he: המילה **Whereas** (ואילו) מעמידה את הפרברים מול מרכז העיר העמוס (**crowded from morning until midnight**), והתוצאה **without meeting a single person** מראה שהם ריקים מאדם, ולכן הם **deserted** (נטושים, ריקים).
explanation.en: **Whereas** sets the suburbs against the **crowded** center, and **without meeting a single person** shows they are empty of people, so they are **deserted**.

items.stem: Although the new can opener was advertised as 'effortless', customers found it ________: it took both hands and a great deal of force to turn the handle.
options: compact
sleek
trendy
clumsy

explanation.he: הנקודתיים מסבירים את המילה החסרה: צריך שתי ידיים וכוח רב כדי לסובב את הידית (**it took both hands and a great deal of force to turn the handle**), וזה ההפך מן ההבטחה **effortless**, ולכן הפותחן הוא **clumsy** (מסורבל).
explanation.en: The colon explains the blank: **it took both hands and a great deal of force to turn the handle**, the opposite of **effortless**, so it is **clumsy** (awkward).

items.stem: Although films often show medieval life as a world of rich nobles, most people were ordinary ________ who worked a small plot of land and usually gave part of each harvest to their lord.
options: monks
sailors
peasants
merchants

explanation.he: המילה **Although** מעמידה עולם של אצילים עשירים (**rich nobles**) מול רוב האנשים, והפרטים **a small plot of land** ו-**part of each harvest to their lord** מגדירים אותם כאיכרים (**peasants**).
explanation.en: **Although** contrasts **rich nobles** with most people, and **a small plot of land** and **part of each harvest to their lord** describe **peasants** (poor farmers).

items.stem: Although most household products are safe to keep in a cupboard, ________ substances, such as gasoline, paint thinner and some cleaning sprays, must be stored away from heat.
options: flammable
synthetic
domestic
solid

explanation.he: הצירוף **such as** מביא דוגמאות (**gasoline, paint thinner and some cleaning sprays**), והסוף **must be stored away from heat** מגדיר את הקבוצה כחומרים **flammable** (דליקים).
explanation.en: **Such as** gives examples (**gasoline, paint thinner and some cleaning sprays**), and **must be stored away from heat** defines the group as **flammable** (easily set on fire).

items.stem: Despite early complaints that the new playground next door would be unbearably noisy, most neighbors have grown ________ to the sound, and many no longer notice it at all.
options: hostile
responsive
accustomed
sympathetic

explanation.he: המילה **Despite** והצירוף **no longer notice it at all** מראים שהתלונות הראשוניות נשכחו והשכנים התרגלו לרעש, ולכן התשובה **accustomed** (מורגל, רגיל).
explanation.en: **Despite** the early complaints, many neighbors **no longer notice it at all**, so they have grown **accustomed** (used) to the sound.

items.stem: Granted, starting school an hour later gives teenagers more time in bed, but if they simply go to sleep an hour later each night, the benefit is ________ by their new bedtimes.
options: neutralized
accompanied
justified
supplied

explanation.he: המילה **Granted** מודה ביתרון (**more time in bed**), והמילה **but** מציגה ניגוד: אם הנערים הולכים לישון מאוחר יותר, היתרון מתבטל, ולכן התשובה **neutralized** (מנוטרל, מבוטל).
explanation.en: **Granted** admits a benefit, but teenagers who **go to sleep an hour later each night** lose it, so the benefit is **neutralized** (canceled out).

items.stem: Reports about rare illnesses are meant to reassure the public that the risk is small, but because their vivid details stay in the mind, such reports can actually ________ people's fear.
options: relieve
regulate
reveal
magnify

explanation.he: המילה **but** והמילה **actually** מסמנות שהתוצאה הפוכה מהכוונה (**meant to reassure the public**), והסיבה **their vivid details stay in the mind** מראה שהפחד גדל, ולכן התשובה היא **magnify** (להגדיל, להעצים).
explanation.en: **But** and **actually** reverse the intention (**meant to reassure the public**), and **their vivid details stay in the mind**, so the reports **magnify** (enlarge) the fear.

items.stem: A childhood nickname often means little to the adult who carries it, yet it can be remarkably ________: even when the person has changed completely, old friends tend to keep using it for decades.
options: childish
persistent
affectionate
casual

explanation.he: הנקודתיים מסבירים את החסר: גם כשהאדם השתנה לגמרי (**even when the person has changed completely**), חברים ותיקים ממשיכים להשתמש בכינוי עשרות שנים, ולכן הכינוי הוא **persistent** (מתמיד, עמיד בפני שינוי).
explanation.en: The colon explains the blank: even when the person **has changed completely**, old friends **keep using it for decades**, so the nickname is **persistent** (long-lasting).

items.stem: Unlike the old campus in the city center, the new campus, set in a salubrious valley, lacks basic ________, such as a café, a bank and a pharmacy.
options: eateries
accommodation
transportation
amenities

explanation.he: הצירוף **such as a café, a bank and a pharmacy** נותן דוגמאות לחסר, והמילה **Unlike** מראה שבקמפוס החדש חסר מה שיש בקמפוס הישן, ולכן התשובה היא **amenities** (מתקני נוחות ושירותי עזר).
explanation.en: **Such as a café, a bank and a pharmacy** gives examples of what **Unlike** says the new campus lacks, so the word is **amenities** (useful facilities and services).

items.stem: Contrary to predictions that television would make speakers from disparate regions sound alike, regional accents have proved ________: young people in many towns proudly keep the sounds of their hometown.
options: resilient
uniform
artificial
delicate

explanation.he: הצירוף **Contrary to predictions** והנקודתיים (**proudly keep the sounds of their hometown**) מראים שהמבטאים אינם נעלמים, ולכן התשובה היא **resilient** (חסין, שורד).
explanation.en: **Contrary to predictions** and the colon (**proudly keep the sounds of their hometown**) show that accents did not disappear, so they are **resilient** (able to survive).

items.stem: While a stand-up comedian can deliver a sardonic joke in plain words, a mime has no voice at all and must ________ the same joke through gestures and facial expressions.
options: recite
tease
convey
suppress

explanation.he: המילה **While** מעמידה קומיקאי שמוסר בדיחה במילים מול פנטומימאי שאין לו קול כלל (**has no voice at all**), ולכן הוא חייב להעביר (**convey**) את הבדיחה דרך תנועות והבעות פנים.
explanation.en: **While** contrasts a comedian who uses plain words with a mime who **has no voice at all**, so the mime must **convey** (express) the joke through gestures and expressions.

items.stem: Admittedly, volunteer fire crews are cheap to run, but they have a problem on weekdays: when an alarm sounds, many of the volunteers are ________ because they are at their jobs, far from the station.
options: unpaid
absent
employed
inexperienced

explanation.he: המילה **but** מציגה בעיה מול היתרון (**cheap to run**), והמשפט הסיבתי **they are at their jobs, far from the station** מסביר שהמתנדבים אינם נמצאים, ולכן התשובה היא **absent** (נעדרים).
explanation.en: **But** introduces a problem against the advantage (**cheap to run**), and **they are at their jobs, far from the station** explains that many volunteers are **absent** (not there).

items.stem: The messaging app is convenient, yet its constant notifications can be distracting, so many users choose to ________ them during the working day.
options: deactivate
activate
reactivate
automate

explanation.he: המילה **yet** מציגה ניגוד ליתרון (**convenient**), והמילה **so** מראה תוצאה של ההפרעה (**distracting**): המשתמשים בוחרים לכבות את ההתראות, ולכן התשובה היא **deactivate** (לבטל, לכבות).
explanation.en: **Yet** contrasts the app's convenience with a problem (**distracting**), and **so** gives the result: users choose to turn the notifications off, that is, **deactivate** them.

items.stem: Although doctors have advised people for years to eat less salt, the habit of adding it to every meal remains deeply ________ in many households.
options: buried
involved
ingrained
interested

explanation.he: הצירוף הקבוע **deeply ingrained** מתאר הרגל שהשתרש, והמילה **Although** מראה שההרגל נשאר למרות שנים של עצות (**doctors have advised people for years**), ולכן התשובה היא **ingrained** (מושרש).
explanation.en: **Although** shows that the habit survives years of advice (**doctors have advised people for years**), and **deeply ingrained** is the fixed phrase for a habit that is hard to change.

items.stem: Once pictured as a slow, clumsy creature, the reptile is now thought to have been highly ________, because the newly found skeleton has long legs and unusually light bones.
options: awkward
agile
aggressive
muscular

explanation.he: הצירוף **Once pictured as a slow, clumsy creature** מציג את התמונה הישנה, והמילה **now** עם הסיבה **long legs and unusually light bones** מראים תמונה הפוכה, ולכן הזוחל היה **agile** (זריז, קל תנועה).
explanation.en: **Once pictured as a slow, clumsy creature** gives the old view, and **now** plus **long legs and unusually light bones** reverse it, so the reptile was **agile** (quick).

items.stem: Though blamed for the summer miasma that leaves Caribbean islanders coughing, dust blown across the Atlantic from the Sahara also ________ the Amazon rainforest, whose poor soils would otherwise lack phosphorus.
options: enriches
contaminates
hydrates
smothers

explanation.he: המילים **Though** ו-**also** מסמנות שהאבק גם מועיל, והוא מספק זרחן שהקרקע הייתה חסרה בלעדיו (**would otherwise lack phosphorus**), ולכן התשובה היא **enriches** (מעשיר).
explanation.en: **Though** and **also** signal a benefit, and soils that **would otherwise lack phosphorus** gain it from the dust, so the dust **enriches** (adds nutrients to) the rainforest.

items.stem: Essays written by hand in a timed exam often contain small ________, such as a doubled 'the' or a dropped letter, which many graders forgive as signs of haste rather than of ignorance.
options: omissions
malapropisms
lapses
redundancies

explanation.he: הדוגמה **a doubled 'the'** (מילה שהוכפלה) והדוגמה **a dropped letter** (אות שנשמטה) הן שני סוגים שונים של טעויות, ורק המילה **lapses** (שגיאות קטנות מהיסח הדעת) מכסה את שתיהן.
explanation.en: **A doubled 'the'** adds a word and **a dropped letter** removes one, so only **lapses** (small slips of attention) covers both examples.

items.stem: Decades of salt spray and winter gales have taken their ________ on the town's storied pier: its planks have rotted, its railings have rusted through, and last spring it was closed to visitors.
options: tariff
fee
duty
toll

explanation.he: המילים **have taken their** שלפני החסר והמילה **on** שאחריו יוצרות רק עם המילה **toll** את הצירוף הקבוע **take a toll on** (לגבות מחיר כבד, לגרום נזק מצטבר).
explanation.en: Only **toll** completes the fixed phrase take a toll on (cause gradual damage), which matches the planks that **have rotted** and the rusted railings.

items.stem: After twenty summers of guiding tourists to the same waterfall, the ranger had grown ________: she still agreed with every glowing word in the guidebook, yet the roaring cascade no longer stirred her.
options: cynical
jaded
enthralled
churlish

explanation.he: הפקחית עדיין מסכימה עם כל מילת שבח (**still agreed with every glowing word**), אבל המפל כבר לא מרגש אותה (**no longer stirred her**), ולכן התשובה היא **jaded** (שהתרגשותו קהתה מרוב היכרות).
explanation.en: She **still agreed with every glowing word**, yet the cascade **no longer stirred her**: twenty summers had made her **jaded** (dulled by overexposure).

items.stem: Asked whether the old house's roof had ever leaked, the real-estate agent ________ without a moment's hesitation, praising the sunny garden and the newly painted kitchen but never answering yes or no.
options: vacillated
stammered
philosophized
prevaricated

explanation.he: הסוכן דיבר בלי היסוס (**without a moment's hesitation**) אבל לא ענה על השאלה (**never answering yes or no**), ולכן התשובה היא **prevaricated** (התחמק, דיבר בעקיפין כדי לא לענות).
explanation.en: He spoke **without a moment's hesitation** but dodged the question, **never answering yes or no**, so he **prevaricated** (spoke evasively).

items.stem: Far from breaking the supermarket's one-coupon-per-customer rule, the wily bargain hunters merely ________ it, sending a cousin, an aunt and a neighbor to the checkout with one coupon each.
options: sidestepped
overstepped
circumscribed
contravened

explanation.he: הצירוף **Far from breaking** אומר שהם לא הפרו את הכלל אלא שלחו קרובי משפחה עם קופון לכל אחד, ולכן התשובה היא **sidestepped** (עקפו את הכלל בלי להפר אותו).
explanation.en: **Far from breaking** the rule, they sent relatives **with one coupon each**, so they **sidestepped** it (got around it without breaking it).

items.sentence: The view from the top of the hill was so ________ that everyone stopped to take pictures.

explanation.he: אחרי הצירוף **was so** צריך שם תואר, והחלק **everyone stopped to take pictures** מראה שהנוף יפה, ולכן התשובה היא **beautiful** (יפה), עם הסיומת **-ful**.
explanation.en: After **was so** we need an adjective, and **everyone stopped to take pictures** shows the view is **beautiful**.

items.sentence: At the market, I bought a big bag of ________ and some onions for our dinner.

explanation.he: אחרי הצירוף **a big bag of** צריך שם עצם ברבים, כמו בצירוף **some onions**, ולכן התשובה היא **potatoes** (תפוחי אדמה), עם הסיומת **-es**.
explanation.en: After **a big bag of** we need a plural noun, like **some onions**: **potatoes**, with **-es**.

items.sentence: When the warm sun came out after lunch, our snowman slowly ________, and by evening only its carrot nose was left.

explanation.he: אחרי הצירוף **our snowman slowly** צריך פועל בעבר, והחלק **only its carrot nose was left** מראה שאיש השלג נעלם, ולכן התשובה היא **disappeared** (נעלם).
explanation.en: After **our snowman slowly** we need a past verb, and **only its carrot nose was left** shows it vanished: **disappeared**.

items.sentence: My sister and I had a loud ________ about who would sit in the front seat, so Dad made us both sit in the back.

explanation.he: אחרי הצירוף **had a loud** צריך שם עצם, ומהפועל **argue** בונים את שם העצם **argument** (ויכוח), בלי האות **e** שבסוף הפועל.
explanation.en: After **had a loud** we need a noun: **argue** drops its **e** before **-ment**, giving **argument**.

items.sentence: Although the power outage was not the hotel's fault, the manager went to every room to ________ and offered each guest a free breakfast.

explanation.he: אחרי הצירוף **went to every room to** צריך פועל בצורת הבסיס, ומשם העצם **apology** יוצרים את הפועל **apologize** (להתנצל), כשהאות **y** נשמטת לפני הסיומת **-ize**.
explanation.en: After **went to every room to** we need a base-form verb: **apology** drops its **y** and adds **-ize**, giving **apologize**.

items.sentence: The exhibition was advertised on every city bus, yet it proved so ________ that a week later visitors could not name a single painting.

explanation.he: אחרי הצירוף **proved so** צריך שם תואר, והחלק **visitors could not name a single painting** מראה שהתערוכה נשכחה מהר, ולכן התשובה היא **forgettable** (שנשכח בקלות).
explanation.en: After **proved so** we need an adjective, and **visitors could not name a single painting** shows it was easily forgotten: **forgettable**.

items.sentence: Admirers credit the engineer's business acumen, but her real asset was a rare ________: she built more than two hundred failed prototypes before her folding bicycle finally worked.

explanation.he: אחרי הצירוף **her real asset was** צריך שם עצם, והחלק **more than two hundred failed prototypes** מראה התמדה, ולכן התשובה היא **perseverance** (התמדה), עם הסיומת **-ance**.
explanation.en: After **her real asset was** we need a noun, and **more than two hundred failed prototypes** shows **perseverance**, spelled with **-ance**.

items.sentence: ________, the watchmaker, who had never let a scratch go unpolished, inspected the clock three times, ignoring the customer's affable but insistent calls to hurry.

explanation.he: בתחילת המשפט ולפני פסיק צריך תואר פועל באות גדולה, והחלק **who had never let a scratch go unpolished** מראה שהבדיקה החוזרת אופיינית לשען, ולכן התשובה היא **Characteristically** (כדרכו).
explanation.en: An opening adverb is needed, and **who had never let a scratch go unpolished** shows the triple check was typical: **Characteristically**.

items.sentence: Only after a journalist visited the factory did it emerge that the shop's fervent fans had been ________ by labels promising hand-knitted scarves.

explanation.he: אחרי הצירוף **had been** ולפני המילה **by** צריך צורה שלישית של פועל, והחלק **labels promising hand-knitted scarves** מראה הטעיה, ולכן התשובה היא **misled** (הוטעו).
explanation.en: After **had been** and before **by** we need a past participle, and **labels promising hand-knitted scarves** shows deception: **misled**.

items.sentence: Even the mediator, renowned for her aplomb, found the two neighbors' demands ________: one insisted that the oak be cut down, the other that it be protected by law.

explanation.he: אחרי הצירוף **found the two neighbors' demands** צריך שם תואר, והדרישות ההפוכות שאחרי הנקודתיים מחייבות שלילה, ולכן התשובה היא **irreconcilable** (שאי אפשר ליישב ביניהן).
explanation.en: After **found the two neighbors' demands** we need an adjective, and the opposite demands after the colon make it negative: **irreconcilable**.

items.sentence: For two decades the station's grand piano ________ silent under a dusty cover, until a retired teacher with a penchant for old jazz began playing it every morning.

explanation.he: אחרי הנושא **the station's grand piano** צריך פועל בעבר, כמו הפועל **began**, והפועל **lie** (להיות מונח) חריג, ולכן התשובה היא **lay** (היה מונח, נותר).
explanation.en: After **the station's grand piano** we need a past verb, like **began**, and **lie** (rest) is irregular: **lay**.

items.sentence: Though my grandparents bought the farmhouse after barely a minute's thought and with little trepidation, the purchase proved ________, shaping the lives of three generations.

explanation.he: אחרי הצירוף **the purchase proved** צריך שם תואר, והחלק **shaping the lives of three generations** מראה חשיבות עצומה, ולכן התשובה היא **momentous** (רב-חשיבות, גורלי).
explanation.en: After **the purchase proved** we need an adjective, and **shaping the lives of three generations** shows great importance: **momentous**.

items.prompt: Would you rather share an apartment with roommates or live alone while you study? Explain your choice.
items.highModel: I would rather share an apartment with roommates than live alone while I study. The first reason is money. Rent near the campus is high, and if I split it with two friends, I can work fewer hours and spend more time on my courses. The second reason is company. After a long day of lectures, it is good to come home to people who understand my problems. Before a hard exam last year, my roommates helped me review until midnight. Of course, roommates sometimes squabble over dirty dishes, but a simple cleaning schedule prevents most arguments. For both money and company, sharing is the better choice for me.

rubricHigh.content: הבחירה מופיעה כבר במשפט הראשון. יש שתי סיבות מסומנות (למשל כסף וחברה), ולכל אחת פרט מוחשי או דוגמה. יש הודאה בחיסרון של הבחירה ופתרון מעשי לו, והסיכום חוזר על שתי הסיבות.
rubricHigh.language: כמעט אין טעויות. המבנה **would rather … than** נכון, יש משפט תנאי (**if I split it …, I can …**), פסוקית זיקה (**people who understand …**) ואוצר מילים מדויק לחיים בדירה משותפת.

items.prompt: Many students work part time while they study at university. Is this a good idea, and why?
items.highModel: In my view, working during a degree is a good idea, as long as the hours stay limited. First, a job teaches skills that are rarely taught in lectures. When I worked at a busy café in my first year, I learned to plan my week and stay calm under pressure. Second, earning my own money made me independent: I no longer had to ask my parents for rent. Admittedly, long shifts of menial work, such as washing dishes, can leave students too tired to study. However, those who limit themselves to about fifteen hours a week can usually keep their grades up. In short, a job is worthwhile, provided that studying comes first.

rubricHigh.content: העמדה מוגבלת בתנאי (**as long as …**). יש שתי סיבות מפותחות, ואחת מהן נתמכת בניסיון אישי. ההסתייגות (**Admittedly …**) מקבלת מענה מעשי (**However …**), והסיכום חוזר לתנאי.
rubricHigh.language: אין טעויות. יש סביל (**are rarely taught**), פסוקיות זמן וזיקה, המבנה **too … to** ומילות קישור מגוונות (**Admittedly**, **However**, **provided that**). אוצר המילים מדויק.

items.prompt: Some high schools require every student to do a set number of hours of volunteer work before graduating. Should all high schools have this requirement, and why?
items.highModel: I believe high schools should require some volunteer work, provided that students choose where to volunteer. First, many teenagers never volunteer simply because nobody asks them. A requirement gets them through the door, and once there, many find helping deeply satisfying. One classmate who complained about her hours at an animal shelter still volunteers there three years later. Second, regular volunteering can instill qualities that classrooms rarely teach, such as reliability and patience. Admittedly, coerced kindness can feel hollow, and some students merely count the hours. Even so, counting hours in a soup kitchen teaches more than never entering one. A requirement, in short, opens doors that many teenagers would otherwise never find.

rubricHigh.content: העמדה ברורה ומוגבלת בתנאי (**provided that …**). הסיבות מפותחות, עם הסבר של המנגנון ועם דוגמה מוחשית. הטענה החזקה ביותר של הצד השני (חסד בכפייה) מוצגת בהגינות ומקבלת מענה ישיר, והסיכום מחזק את העמדה.
rubricHigh.language: אין טעויות. יש פסוקית מקוצרת (**once there**), פסוקית זיקה (**One classmate who complained …**), מחבר של תנאי (**provided that**) ומילות קישור של הסתייגות (**Admittedly**, **Even so**). אוצר המילים מדויק ועשיר.

items.prompt: Many parents now use phone apps that show them where their teenage children are at any moment. Is this a reasonable way to keep teenagers safe, and why?
items.highModel: Tracking is a reasonable way to keep teenagers safe, I would argue, but only when they know about it and the monitoring shrinks as trust grows. Used openly, an app is a sensible safety net: a sixteen-year-old on the last bus home may welcome knowing someone would notice a delay. Far from making teenagers safer, however, tracking them surreptitiously teaches them to hide more, since those who discover it learn only that they are distrusted. Admittedly, parents cannot always judge which risks are real. Yet an overbearing parent who never loosens control denies a teenager the practice in judging risk that adulthood demands. Tracking, then, should be a temporary bridge, not a permanent leash.

rubricHigh.content: העמדה מסויגת ומבוססת על תנאי כפול (המתבגר יודע על המעקב, והמעקב מצטמצם עם הזמן). שני מקרים מנוגדים בודקים את התנאי, יש הסתייגות (**Admittedly …**) ומענה עליה (**Yet …**), והסיכום חוזר לתנאי בדימוי חד.
rubricHigh.language: אין טעויות. התחביר מתקדם וטבעי: פסוקית מקוצרת (**Used openly, …**), המבנה **Far from + -ing**, צירופי שם עצם דחוסים (**the practice in judging risk that adulthood demands**) וסייג (**I would argue**). אוצר המילים מדויק ועשיר.
